faq: Is dropshipping legal in Nigeria?
Yes. You are a reseller. Sell genuine products, describe them honestly and follow our Seller rules.
How much can I make?
You set your price. Each product shows what you keep after the supplier’s price and fees.
Who handles returns?
Returns go back to the supplier with a free label. You don’t pay for wrong or damaged items.
Can I dropship from China?
Yes, with Imports from China. Rex shows the full landed cost before you pay.
seo: Dropshipping means selling products you don’t keep in stock. When a customer orders, the supplier packs and sends it straight to them.

Local dropshipping is faster than importing for every order, because suppliers are in Nigeria and deliveries take days, not weeks. Shopinbos checks every supplier and holds payments until delivery, so both sides are protected.
